name: Klockmort Spannerspan
summary: Furen Longbeard sends fire-hardened mail findings from Stormwind to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge. The dwarf smith shares his discoveries with his gnomish colleague in Tinkertown.

sections.title: A Colleague in Tinkertown
sections.body: Furen Longbeard has forged fire-hardened mail and gathered his findings for a fellow craftsman. He trusts you to carry his notes from Stormwind to Ironforge, then into Tinkertown, where Klockmort Spannerspan works as a gnomish blacksmith.

sections.title: Gnomish Excitement
sections.body: Gnomish blacksmiths are rare among their dwarven hosts, and Klockmort is eager to push beyond traditional metalwork. He studies Furen's notes and grows excited about the breakthrough, ready to try the fiery techniques in his own unusual projects.

faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan works as a gnomish blacksmith in Tinkertown, within Ironforge. He collaborates with dwarven smiths such as Furen Longbeard on metalworking techniques.

faq.q: Why does Furen Longbeard send you to Klockmort?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard records what he discovered while crafting fire-hardened mail. He sends you to deliver the notes because Klockmort is keen to invent, and can experiment with Furen's findings.

faq.q: Where can I find Klockmort Spannerspan?
faq.answer: You can find Klockmort Spannerspan in Tinkertown, the gnome district in eastern Ironforge, among workbenches and machinery.

faq.q: What happens after giving Klockmort the notes?
faq.answer: Furen's breakthrough excites Klockmort, who begins planning his own metalworking projects. He sends you to gather unusual materials such as iron coral.

faq.q: Is this quest limited to warriors?
faq.answer: Yes. This delivery belongs to an armor-crafting chain for Alliance warriors training under veteran weapon and armor masters.

faq.q: Why does Klockmort say he cannot tell day from night?
faq.answer: Ironforge lies beneath the mountains of Dun Morogh. In Tinkertown, stone vaults and glowing lamps keep craftsmen from seeing the sun or sky.

angles.text: As a warrior, you follow a path toward durable battle gear, from dwarven hearths to gnomish invention, and earn the attention of Tinkertown's finest.
As a gnome, you see Klockmort bring dwarven metalworking together with gnomish experimentation in Tinkertown.
As a blacksmith, you carry Furen's notes in an exchange of advanced smithing techniques among Ironforge's master artisans.
